import asyncio

# Let's read in larger chunks to find key sections
async def read_chunks():
    text = ""
    for offset in range(0, 27546, 3000):
        chunk = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 3000)
        text += chunk
    return text

full_text = await read_chunks()

# Find key sections
import re

# Find [grade]
for m in re.finditer(r'\[grade\](.*?)(?=\[|\Z)', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(f"[grade] found at {m.start()}: {m.group(1)[:500]}")
    print("---")

# Find [grader tail]
for m in re.finditer(r'\[grader tail\](.*?)(?=\[|\Z)', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(f"[grader tail] found at {m.start()}: {m.group(1)[:1000]}")
    print("---")

# Find [facts]
for m in re.finditer(r'\[facts\](.*?)(?=\[|\Z)', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(f"[facts] found at {m.start()}: {m.group(1)[:1500]}")
    print("---")

# Find [first wrong step]
for m in re.finditer(r'\[first wrong step\](.*?)(?=\[|\Z)', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(f"[first wrong step] found at {m.start()}: {m.group(1)[:1500]}")
    print("---")

# Find Verifier verdict
for m in re.finditer(r'Verifier verdict.*?(?=\n|$)', full_text):
    print(f"Verifier verdict: {m.group()}")
    print("---")

# Find failing checks
for m in re.finditer(r'failing checks.*?(?=\n|$)', full_text):
    print(f"failing: {m.group()}")
    print("---")

print("\n\nFull text length:", len(full_text))
print("\nLast 2000 chars:")
print(full_text[-2000:])
